opportunities.title: Small Grants – UK round – deadline 15 September 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds; individuals are not eligible unless they can provide organisational support. Projects must involve UK and Japan partners.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for collaborative projects between the UK and Japan across arts, culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine, health, science, youth, education and sport, encouraging mutual understanding and lasting collaboration.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards – deadline 1 December 2026

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total for multi‑year projects

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record; open to health professionals, researchers, practitioners, managers, carers and others in medicine and health who can establish UK‑Japan collaborations. Preference for early‑career applicants and those without prior UK‑Japan collaboration.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, covering travel, conference and publication costs, for projects up to three years.
